verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair question for a digital tax-services platform, but the evidence shows no user-definable rules or triggers. The email subscriptions (hmrc-docs-19) are an adjacent notification feature. The Making Tax Digital REST API (hmrc-probe-1) is a developer building block that third-party software could use to build automation. Neither is the product's own rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
